name: THE COLONEL, IN HIS DOORWAY
note: THE COLONEL STUCK IN HIS OWN DOORWAY (doc 115 II-5; errata 246): on the funeral day, until Thad pushes him through, he stands in the Company's door on Main Street behind a wreath wider than it. act2-papers operations 1 and 5 (reference/act2-papers/handback.md section 1), every frame anchored on the wreath's ring. Examined and tried through doc 115's THE COLONEL, IN HIS DOORWAY; PUSH sets T_COLONEL_OUT and he goes when he has thanked Thad for it.
barksNote: He is heard through his own LISTEN lines and his TALK TO (doc 115).
walkToNote: On the boardwalk at his right hand, a shoulder's reach from the wreath.

sprite.frameNote: 0 pushing politely from inside, his face over the wreath · 1 breath (derived) · 2 a harder push, his hat askew · 3 the wreath alone (not played here).
sprite.figureHeightNote: ERRATA 235 (Tyler, 2026-11-09: everyone within 3% of Thad). Crown to sole under his top hat, read from his eyes and chin: 364. Was 352 (tools/art/figure-height.py --hat, which counted his collar as the brim): 1.03 of Thad.

leaves.note: Doc 115 II-5: "He goes up the street with the wreath on his arm." He has no walk (errata 99 N), so he fades, once he has said his thanks (errata 246).
